cues.en: Well, they started to do the types of behaviors that they were doing when the food appeared,

cues.zh: 比如一只在梳理羽毛，就会一直梳理羽毛，
cues.en: so, if one was preening itself then it would keep preening itself,

cues.zh: 期待食物会来，
cues.en: with the expectation that food was coming,

cues.zh: 还有这只，也许在啄地面；
cues.en: and this one, maybe he was pecking the ground;

cues.zh: 重点是，它们开始表现出这些迷信行为，
cues.en: so, the point being they started to engage in these superstitious behaviors,

cues.zh: 因为它们把某种因果关系联系了起来，
cues.en: um, because they had related some sort of cause and effect,

cues.zh: 但实际上那里并没有因果关系，
cues.en: but there actually wasn't a cause and effect there,

cues.zh: 对我来说，这在一定程度上解释了整个 YouTube 倦怠现象，
cues.en: and to me, this partly explains the whole YouTube burnout phenomenon,

cues.zh: 因为这些创作者拼命压榨自己去追逐那套算法，
cues.en: because you have these creators who are stretching themselves to try to chase that algorithm

cues.zh: 而算法却在不断变化，
cues.en: meanwhile the algorithm is constantly shifting

cues.zh: 所以你永远不觉得自己是专家，也永远搞不清到底发生了什么
cues.en: and so you never feel like an expert and never quite know what's going on

cues.zh: 尽管你一直试图把因果联系起来
cues.en: even though you're constantly trying to relate cause and effect

cues.zh: 现在我能理解为什么算法必须改变了。
cues.en: now I can understand why the algorithm has to change.

cues.zh: 我是说在YouTube早期，情况是这样的：如果你有订阅者，你就稳了
cues.en: I mean in the early days of YouTube, it was this situation where if you had subscribers you were golden

cues.zh: 因为下次你上传内容时
cues.en: because the next time you uploaded some content

cues.zh: YouTube就会把它展示给你所有的订阅者，视频会获得大量播放
cues.en: then YouTube would show it to all your subscribers it'll get a ton of views

cues.zh: YouTube会说“哦，这是个热门视频”，把它展示给更多人，让你获得更多订阅者
cues.en: YouTube would say "oh this is a popular video", show it to even more people, getting you even more subscribers

cues.zh: 所以下次你发布另一个视频时，它就会触达更多订阅者、更多播放
cues.en: so the next time you launch another video then it goes to more subscribers more views

cues.zh: 这就是一个正反馈循环，你的频道会不断成长、成长、再成长
cues.en: and it was just this positive feedback loop where you would grow and grow and grow a channel

cues.zh: 所以富者愈富，小频道则一直很小
cues.en: so the rich got richer and small channels stayed small

cues.zh: 所以显然我们需要一些东西来打破这个循环
cues.en: so obviously we needed something to break the cycle

cues.zh: 于是YouTube开始做一些实验
cues.en: and so YouTube started doing some experiments

cues.zh: 本质上就是改变推荐给你受众的内容
cues.en: where they would essentially change what was recommended to your audience

cues.zh: 他们会停止展示某些订阅者的部分内容
cues.en: so they would stop showing some of the content from certain subscribers

cues.zh: 然后观察播放量发生了什么变化
cues.en: and they saw what happened to views

cues.zh: 于是他们开始把这些订阅者与频道解绑
cues.en: so they started disconnecting these subscribers from the channel

cues.zh: 订阅不再意味着“我想看这个人的每一个视频”
cues.en: No longer was a subscription like "I want to see every video by this person"

cues.zh: 而更像是一种暗示：也许这个人创作的内容是我可能想看的
cues.en: it was more of a suggestion that maybe something this person creates is something I might like to see

cues.zh: 而YouTube发现，当他们这么做时
cues.en: and what YouTube found when they did that

cues.zh: 平台上的播放量、观看时长都大幅上升
cues.en: was that the number of views on the platform the amount of watch time all rose dramatically

cues.zh: 所以对YouTube来说，为了实现网站增长，他们发现降低订阅的重要性至关重要
cues.en: so for YouTube to get growth of the site they found that reducing the importance of subscriptions was essential

cues.zh: 仔细想想，这其实挺有道理的
cues.en: and this kind of makes sense if you think about it

cues.zh: 我的意思是，就算你做了一期很棒的视频
cues.en: I mean if you make one great video,

cues.zh: 也不代表你接下来做的每一期视频都会很棒
cues.en: that doesn't necessarily mean that every video you're gonna make is gonna be great

cues.zh: 所以YouTube介入进来是有道理的
cues.en: so it makes sense for YouTube to step in

cues.zh: 在决定什么内容展示给哪类观众这件事上发挥一些作用
cues.en: and play some role in terms of determining what gets shown to which audience members

cues.zh: 正如MatPat之前所观察到的那样
cues.en: Now, as has been observed by MatPat previously,

cues.zh: 远离订阅模式让YouTube退回到了当年街头卖报纸的状态
cues.en: moving away from subscriptions moves YouTube back to what it was like to sell newspapers on the street

cues.zh: 你必须真正激发人们在当下就购买
cues.en: you really had to inspire people to buy on the spot

cues.zh: 你得端出非常耸人听闻的新闻。这也被称为黄色新闻。
cues.en: you have to serve up really sensational news items. This is also called yellow journalism.

cues.zh: 直到报纸建立了订阅模式
cues.en: it was only once the newspapers built subscription models

cues.zh: 报纸才能让严肃新闻成为现实，成为他们专注去做的事
cues.en: that newspapers could make sober journalism a reality, something that they focused on

cues.zh: 因为他们已经抓住了你的眼球，不必再为那种注意力去争抢
cues.en: because they already had your eyeballs, they didn't have to fight for that sort of attention

cues.zh: 他们不必那么耸人听闻
cues.en: they didn't have to be as sensational

cues.zh: 但YouTube正在往相反的方向走
cues.en: but YouTube is going in the opposite direction

cues.zh: 降低订阅者的重要性，就意味着提升耸人听闻的重要性
cues.en: reducing the importance of subscribers means increasing the importance of sensationalism

cues.zh: 以及标题党式的缩略图
cues.en: and click-baity thumbnails

cues.zh: 所以几周前我去参加了纽约的创作者峰会
cues.en: and so a few weeks ago I was out at the creator summit in New York

cues.zh: 并且见到了MrBeast。
cues.en: and I met MrBeast.

cues.zh: 我给他看了我正在剪的一个视频片段，是关于洛杉矶水库遮阳球的
cues.en: I showed him some of the footage from this video I was working on about the shade balls in LA Reservoir

cues.zh: MrBeast 只看了一眼，就对我说
cues.en: and MrBeast took one look at it, and he said to me

cues.zh: “绝对要爆”
cues.en: that's a banger

cues.zh: 我觉得挺有意思的，但很显然他当时就知道这视频一定会大火
cues.en: which I think it's pretty funny but I think clearly he knew that this was going to be a video that would take off

cues.zh: 接着我们聊了标题和封面图
cues.en: and we talked about titles and thumbnails

cues.zh: 你可能注意到了，封面图其实借鉴了他以前在后院玩麦片和 Orbeez 水晶球的风格
cues.en: you might have noticed that the thumbnail borrows a bit from say his work with cereal and Orbeez in backyards

cues.zh: 我告诉他我原本打算起名叫
cues.en: and I told him that I was thinking about calling it something like,

cues.zh: 《投放遮阳球》
cues.en: Throwing Shade Balls

cues.zh: 他直接说：“不行。”
cues.en: and he was like, "No".

cues.zh: 他建议改成：《为什么这个湖上有 9600 万个黑球？》
cues.en: He suggested, why are there 96 million black balls on this lake

cues.zh: 后来我把“湖”改成了“水库”，毕竟实事求是嘛，它确实是水库
cues.en: Now I changed it to reservoir because I mean let's be real that's what it is

cues.zh: 但这足以说明标题和封面到底有多重要
cues.en: but it just goes to show how important the title and thumbnail are

cues.zh: 和 MrBeast 聊完后我学到一件事：视频能不能爆，归结起来就两个指标
cues.en: what I learned talking to MrBeast was that going viral you can boil down to two metrics:

cues.zh: 想让视频爆火，你必须做好两件事
cues.en: you need to do two things with your video in order for it to go viral

cues.zh: 我说的爆火，是指像他频道那样拿到几千万的播放量
cues.en: and I mean tens of millions of views as his channel shows

cues.zh: 好，第一点可能并不让人意外，那就是观看时长。
cues.en: Okay the first thing, maybe not surprising, is watch time.

cues.zh: 当人们点击你的视频时，他们实际上必须观看相当大的一部分
cues.en: so when people click on your video they actually have to watch a significant portion of it

cues.zh: 如果这部分大约是七八分钟，那就很有用
cues.en: It's useful if that's sort of seven or eight minutes

cues.zh: 那是他们实际观看的时间，所以你需要一个比这更长的视频，
cues.en: now that is the actual time that they watch, so you need a longer video than that,

cues.zh: 比如15分钟，如果你想让平均观看时间保持在7到8分钟左右
cues.en: say 15 minutes, if you want the average watch time to be around that 7 or 8 minute mark

cues.zh: 对我来说，观看时长并不是一个让我感到兴奋的指标
cues.en: Now for me, watch time is not that exciting of a metric to know that I have to hit

cues.zh: 因为我知道大多数人已经看了我大部分的视频
cues.en: because I know that most people already watch most of my videos

cues.zh: 所以对我来说，最大的领悟来自第二点
cues.en: so for me the big insight came with number two

cues.zh: 如果你想要一个爆款视频，你需要有很高的点击率
cues.en: if you want a viral video you need to have a high click-through rate

cues.zh: 也就是你的标题和缩略图的总点击次数
cues.en: so that is the total number of clicks on your titles and thumbnails

cues.zh: 除以标题和缩略图被展示的次数
cues.en: divided by the number of times that title and thumbnail have been shown

cues.zh: 这就是你的点击率
cues.en: that is your click-through rate

cues.zh: MrBeast给我看了这张图，显示当你接近10%、20%、30%的点击率时
cues.en: and MrBeast showed me this graph showing that as you approach 10% 20% 30% click-through rate

cues.zh: 那么视频获得的观看量和曝光量
cues.en: then the number of views and the number of impressions that video will get

cues.zh: 就会飙升。它会 dramatic 地跳跃
cues.en: Just skyrockets. It jumps dramatically

cues.zh: 一方面这有点合理
cues.en: now on the one hand that kind of makes sense

cues.zh: 因为你知道人们在点击视频，显然你会获得更多观看
cues.en: because you know people are clicking a video obviously you're going to get more views

cues.zh: 但增长是如此剧烈
cues.en: but it is such a dramatic increase

cues.zh: 以至于它真的把网站变成了一个标题和缩略图就是一切的地方
cues.en: that it really turns the site into a place where the title and thumbnail are everything

cues.zh: 你可以有一个很棒的视频，但除非你有一个很棒的钩子来吸引人们进来
cues.en: you can have a great video but unless you have a great hook to get people in

cues.zh: 它就不会火
cues.en: it's not going to go viral

cues.zh: 所以听到这么多不同的 YouTuber
cues.en: and so it was amazing to hear all these different YouTubers

cues.zh: 讨论他们如何优化缩略图，真的很让人大开眼界
cues.en: talk about how they optimized a thumbnail

cues.zh: 很多人告诉我，在为新视频制作缩略图时
cues.en: many people told me that when they were working on a thumbnail for a new video

cues.zh: 他们其实会用 Photoshop 把它 P 到自己当前的 YouTube 首页截图上
cues.en: they would actually Photoshop it onto a screenshot of their current YouTube home screen

cues.zh: 放在不同位置，看看它到底有多吸睛
cues.en: in various positions and just see how eye catching it was

cues.zh: 他们真的很拼，就为了让这些缩略图尽可能吸引人点击
cues.en: they're really working hard to make these thumbnails as clickable as possible

cues.zh: 这简直就是把缩略图武器化了
cues.en: it's like weaponizing the thumbnail

cues.zh: 而随着实时点击率功能的推出，这场军备竞赛只会愈演愈烈
cues.en: and that arms race is only set to increase with the introduction of real-time click-through rate

cues.zh: 这个功能一两个月内就会上线
cues.en: which is coming out in a month or two

cues.zh: 所以你可以预见的是
cues.en: so what you can bet will happen

cues.zh: 创作者们发布视频后，就会守在电脑前，准备好各种不同版本的缩略图
cues.en: is that creators will launch a video and then they'll be sitting there with all these different variants of thumbnails

cues.zh: 不断替换它们，观察点击率的变化
cues.en: and they'll be swapping them out and looking at what that does to click-through rate

cues.zh: 然后选择那个能带来最高点击率的版本
cues.en: and then going with the one that leads to the greatest click-through rate

cues.zh: 你可以想象，如果你不这么做，就会被甩在后面
cues.en: and you can imagine, if you don't do this, you're gonna be left behind

cues.zh: 因为其他创作者都在那儿不停换缩略图
cues.en: because all the other creators are sitting there swapping their thumbnails

cues.zh: 就为了让自己的视频获得尽可能最高的互动率
cues.en: to get the highest engagement that they possibly can on their videos

cues.zh: 如果你不这样做，你的视频最终就会被埋没
cues.en: and if you're not doing that, then your videos will end up getting buried

cues.zh: 那么，认清这就是 YouTube 的现实之后
cues.en: So, acknowledging that this is the reality of YouTube

cues.en: First and foremost, I want to keep making high-quality videos

cues.en: because if I don't do that I'm not going to be happy

cues.zh: 我不会满意，你们也不会满意
cues.en: I won't be satisfied and neither will you

cues.zh: 其次，我得选择更有点击欲的选题
cues.en: but second of all I'm gonna have to choose topics that are more clickable

cues.zh: 因为坦白说，如果我要在一个视频上花几天、几周甚至几个月
cues.en: because frankly if I'm going to work for days and weeks and months on a video

cues.zh: 我希望那个视频能拿到比如一千万播放量，而不是五十万
cues.en: I would like that video to get say 10 million views instead of half a million

cues.zh: 所以很大程度上就取决于“这个选题有没有点击欲”
cues.en: so a lot of that comes down to "is this topic clickable"

cues.zh: 然后第三点，我得用一些标题党和吸睛封面
cues.en: and so or number three I'm gonna have to use some clickbaity titles and thumbnails

cues.zh: 为此我道个歉
cues.en: and I apologize for that

cues.zh: 但这看起来就是个生存威胁
cues.en: but it just seems like it's an existential threat

cues.zh: 如果你不这么做，你的频道就撑不了多久
cues.en: that if you don't do that your channel will not be around for very long

cues.zh: 然后你就会一路下滑
cues.en: and you'll be on that sort of downward slide

cues.zh: 我很想知道你们的想法，觉得这是好主意还是坏主意
cues.en: I'd love to know what you think, If you think it's a good idea a bad idea

cues.zh: 我完全愿意听你们说
cues.en: I'm totally open to hearing you out

cues.zh: CaseyNeistat 说过他得信任自己的观众，相信他们会回来看他
cues.en: CaseyNeistat talked about how he's got to trust his audience, you know to come back to him

cues.zh: 事实是，观众只有看到你的标题和封面，才知道你还在
cues.en: the truth is, the audience only knows you're there if they see your titles and thumbnails

cues.zh: 前阵子我去 B&H 买东西，那哥们儿说
cues.en: I went to buy something at B&H a little while ago, and the guy was like

cues.zh: “哦嘿我超爱你的视频！”然后他问，“你还在做吗？”
cues.en: "oh hey I love your videos!" and then he said, "are you still making them?"

cues.en: and I was like, "yeah yeah I'm making them. How do you not know?"

cues.zh: 我也在视频底下看到评论，有人说，

cues.en: "oh great here's a veritasium video see you again in six months"

cues.en: but you can only know that they're there if they surface

cues.zh: 浮到冰山尖尖尖尖的顶端
cues.en: to the tip of the tip of the tip of the tip of the iceberg

cues.zh: 而现在这就是个点击率游戏
cues.en: which now is a click-through rate game

cues.zh: 一方面，你可能会对现在这套玩法有点失望
cues.en: On the one hand, you could be a little bit disappointed by the way the game is working right now

cues.zh: 但另一方面，我倒是想请你想想有没有更好的办法
cues.en: but on the other hand I challenge you to think of a better way

cues.zh: 因为他们能展示潜在感兴趣视频的位置就那么多
cues.en: because they have this limited real estate in which to show people potential videos they might be interested in

cues.zh: 他们当然想把最可能被点击的视频放上去
cues.en: and of course they want to put the videos there that people are most likely to click

cues.zh: 而且是点了之后最可能看完的那些
cues.en: and then most likely to watch once they've clicked it

cues.zh: 我心里有一部分觉得，行吧，这倒也还算公平
cues.en: and like part of me is like, yeah I guess that's kind of fair

cues.zh: 难道你会主张，应该放一些人们不太可能点击的视频上去吗？
cues.en: would you make the argument that you should put some videos there that people are less likely to click?

cues.en: No. I mean, that doesn't seem to make any sense.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得这是不可避免的、理性的终点
cues.en: so I kind of feel like this is the inevitable, rational endpoint

cues.zh: 对于任何试图优化人们观看内容的算法来说
cues.en: for any algorithm that is trying to optimize what people are watching

cues.zh: 我们想给你那些你想看的东西，你通过点击来表达你的欲望
cues.en: we want to give you the things that you want to watch and you indicate your desire by clicking on them

cues.zh: 但这样做也意味着，那些不那么吸引人、不那么耸人听闻的东西
cues.en: but by doing that it also means that things that are just less catchy, less sensational

cues.zh: 无法上升到这个层次
cues.en: don't rise into this level here

cues.en: and I wonder more broadly, how does that affect us?

cues.en: How does that affect the YouTube platform?

cues.en: if the YouTube platform becomes a real clickbait site

cues.en: Who wants to go there?

cues.en: What types of audience will come there?

cues.en: Will there even be an audience for educational content?

cues.en: I think it's all these decisions about the system and the algorithm that determine

cues.en: what the actual media looks like

cues.zh: 创作了什么内容
cues.en: what content is created

cues.en: what people come to the site

cues.en: what audiences are served there
